outcome: Product QA can accept only an exact immutable deployment subject whose Frontend and Backend deployable identities, correctness-relevant configuration and observed runtime identities are pinned and independently verified, preserving the distinction between deployment publication, runtime observation and quality acceptance.
currentProblem: The delivered system includes Backend/QA application slices, the organization boundary, bounded domain execution, and mutation-current authoritative publication, but it does not provide exact Frontend/Backend deployable provenance, a DevOps DeploymentRelease, an immutable AcceptanceSnapshot, independent runtime-identity observation, or Product QA QualityAcceptance over one exact deployed product subject.
constraints: Source revision is not deployable artifact identity.
Mutable image tag or alias is not immutable deployment identity.
QA strategy success is not equivalent to QualityAcceptance ACCEPT.
A caller-selected subset of component refs cannot prove acceptance completeness.
Deployment change during the QA verification window cannot produce current acceptance for the newer release.
DevOps and Product QA remain separate authority domains for deployment publication and quality judgment.
successCriteria: Exact Frontend and Backend deployable identities are traceable from accepted delivery/build provenance into one immutable DeploymentRelease.
AcceptanceSnapshot deterministically pins the exact required components, release, acceptance criteria, environment and verifier policy without omission or cross-release substitution.
Independent runtime observation detects mismatch between expected and actually served component identity and prevents current acceptance.
A mixed old/new rollout is blocked or inconclusive by default rather than silently accepted.
Deployment change before QA starts invalidates the current verification target; deployment change during QA prevents current QualityAcceptance publication for the changed release.
Old snapshots and acceptances remain reconstructable historical evidence after a newer release becomes current.
A fresh consumer can trace source delivery to build provenance, exact deployable, DeploymentRelease, AcceptanceSnapshot, RuntimeObservation and QualityAcceptance without prior conversation state.
